_comment: Least-privilege policy for SkyPilot to run the Cairn spot fleet, attached to the 'cairn-skypilot' IAM user. DEPLOYED AS A CUSTOMER-MANAGED policy named 'cairn-skypilot' (account 615809814090) — migrated from an inline user policy on 2026-06-24 because adding the NA regions pushed the non-whitespace size past the 2048-char INLINE cap (managed cap = 6144). Re-apply via `aws iam create-policy-version` (admin) or the console JSON editor (paste this doc minus '_comment'). HARDENED + SkyPilot-aligned (2026-06-21, after `sky check`; NA regions added 2026-06-24 after a spot-price sweep found us-east-2/us-west-2 cheapest): the H5/H6 region-lock applies ONLY to MUTATING actions — provisioning is locked to [eu-south-2, ap-northeast-2, us-east-2, us-west-2] and destructive instance actions are additionally gated on the 'cairn=true' tag. Read-only ec2:Describe*/Get* is allowed in ANY region because SkyPilot must enumerate regions/AZs/capacity to launch (+ pricing:GetProducts/DescribeServices/GetAttributeValues — the read-only, any-region Price List API for on-demand price discovery that feeds the GPU spot inventory) (read-only, no cost, no resource creation → low blast radius). S3 is scoped to skypilot-*/sky-* buckets (+ global ListAllMyBuckets, a names-only list SkyPilot's check requires). iam:CreateServiceLinkedRole is limited to spot.amazonaws.com. Re-validate with `sky check aws` + a live launch; if an action still fails, add THAT action specifically — never Resource:*. [test: live sky check + launch]
